# 0018: Post images generated by a third-party AI image service

- Date: 2026-10-17
- Status: proposed
- Revised by: [0022](0022-carousels-in-mvp.md) (the no-text rule applies to image Posts only; carousel slides carry text from the copy, checked by a Text Checker)

## Context

This record supersedes [ADR 0009](0009-branded-templates-over-real-photos.md), which rendered post images in our backend: the Art Director filled branded HTML templates with the Owner's real photos and Playwright/Chromium turned them into JPEGs. That ties the backend to a ~1 GB Chromium process and limits visual variety to a handful of templates.

The team wants a different core flow: the Owner asks the agent for a new Instagram post and sends a set of photos (around 10); an image generation model produces several themed variations based on the Brand Brain and current trends; the Owner picks one and approves it ([ADR 0007](0007-approve-every-post.md)). Provider options are compared in [research/image-generation-providers.md](../research/image-generation-providers.md).

## Decision

Post images are **generated by a third-party AI image generation service**, using the Owner's photos as reference images plus the Brand Brain and a trend brief as the prompt. The backend never composes images: it calls the service, resizes or crops the result to 1080×1350 when the provider's size differs, stores it in Supabase Storage and sends it to the Owner. The service sits behind an `ImageGenPort`, like the other external services; the port already existed as an optional seam with a `NoneImageGen` default and becomes the primary path for image Posts.

Each request produces several variations; the Owner chooses one, and nothing is published until the Owner approves it.

The provider is chosen in [ADR 0019](0019-image-provider-gemini.md). The source of "current trends", the number of variations per request and how the Owner picks one are not decided yet (see [open questions](../open-questions.md)).

## Consequences

- No Chromium, Playwright or HTML templates in the backend; the container is small and fits the Railway Trial's 1 GB of RAM ([ADR 0017](0017-backend-host-railway.md)).
- A new provider account, API key and per-image cost; each variation is a paid call, and generation latency adds to the post flow.
- Generated images can alter the product or invent details (text, prices, logos). This conflicts with "agents never invent facts", so prompts must forbid invented text and offers, and Owner approval stays mandatory.
- The Owner's photos are sent to one more third party.
- Docs built on ADR 0009 must be updated: the Art Director and render spec ([agents.md](../architecture/agents.md)), the Renderer ([integrations.md](../architecture/integrations.md)), [post-templates.md](../design/post-templates.md), the post flows ([user-flows.md](../product/user-flows.md)) and the build tasks.
